mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crowd_source_data (trip_id, keyword, source_platform, extracted_item, poi_relation, mention_count, created_time) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{keyword}, #{sourcePlatform}, #{extractedItem}, #{poiRelation}, #{mentionCount}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crowd_source_data WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY mention_count DESC
SELECT * FROM crowd_source_data WHERE keyword = #{keyword} ORDER BY mention_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crowd_source_data WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
